title: Third-Moment Integrability of a Pair Summand
statement: For any natural number $n$, any correlation parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, any coefficient vector $a\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb R$, and any coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the corresponding two-dimensional summand is in $L^3$ with respect to the correlated-pair distribution on the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $n$ coordinates
$i$ is an index among those coordinates
